title: Gibboney's Aerostation LLC
specs: Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by a parent
No recent surgery, broken bones or joint replacement within previous two years
Can accommodate large groups with multiple balloons
blurb: Guests can take tethered balloon rides or full hot air balloon flights. Flights typically last about one hour, with the entire experience taking two to three hours including pre-flight and post-flight activities. Passengers may participate in balloon operations as honorary crew members and receive a personalized flight certificate and a celebratory toast after the flight.
extraNote: All flights are weather dependent · Call to check availability of flights · Health safety protocols in place during pandemic, updated as needed · 2020 Stringtown Road, Grove City, OH (Behind the Applebee’s)
